title: Fourth-round editing responsiveness improvements
scope: 30 NEW Soundscaper-reachable production command/domain costs: freeze12, source9, mixer/track9. Interactive application and freeze publication only; excludes startup, earlier implemented74 and rounds2/3 costs.
validation: Focused owned and adjacent production tests:104 passed, zero failed/skipped. Type-aware ESLint passed all17 owned lintable files. Complete frozen baseline draft/result/error hashes:303 exact. Independent DSP-agent review:516 exact comparisons, including six accessor/species/custom-collection regressions; these receipts are separate and are not claimed as disjoint case counts. Final root static/product/Electron/browser gates are recorded separately.

parity.method: Independent frozen-revision and current esbuild bundles each resolve own production factories/runtime brands. SHA256 hashes complete key-sorted JSON-safe mutated draft, complete result or explicit undefined marker, and error name/message. Stacks/private symbols/functions are not persisted domain output. No timing or shared cross-module brands.
parity.coverage: Reprobe/rewrite/remove/update, payload holes/custom map/duplicate IDs, effects unchanged controls, lane reorder/group duplicate authority, removal partial writes, bus duplicate/late-null, send getter/valueOf mutation, freeze CAS/stale/ownership/missing/duplicate/malformed error precedence, master/track field admission. Actual Soundscaper surface/public commands and source accessor/authority/coercion/species/custom collection regressions; custom lane filter order.

measurements.method: Own checkout factories/brands; full draft/result/error parity outside timers; normalized fixtures/payloads outside timers;32warmups and34 alternating raw pairs with host snapshots and bundle hashes.
measurements.limits: Node command/domain kernels, not Electron click latency. V21 mixer surface and freeze kernels reach Soundscaper production; legacy mixer handlers are unchanged. Small controls retained; no per-entry causal timing claims. This development receipt uses checkouts with different surrounding foreign code, recorded revisions, tracked changes and bundle hashes; final attribution requires the root-owned paired comparison with identical surrounding committed code. Final Electron default Speed results belong to the root report.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Descriptor admission made dense in-use rejection4.4x slower; original path fully restored.
Whole-rack descriptor guard made dense single insert1.87x slower; original path fully restored.
Descriptor admission added a full preflight to one filter; candidate rejected without retaining it or claiming a timing.
Measured11–13% slower on30controls/90racks and6.7% slower on120controls/360racks despite fewer rack reads; original per-control path fully restored.
Dense audio guarded no-op2.20x and dense video1.10x slower; both original splice paths restored.
Guarded4clip/120rack removal1.96x slower, and further mutable/getter admission would increase work; original second lookup fully restored.

Accessor collection entries and changes getters could alter first-source authority; requireSource and publication findIndex are fully restored. Two counted replacements are the separate selected clip/source record admission copies during freeze installation.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Soundscaper intercepts mixer commands before shared legacy handlers; all three optimizations restored/excluded, replaced with actual V21 surface production costs.
